text:
anya: quick UX check on the compact alert row - attached gif + two states: suppressed + active preview. link: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/compact-alert-row-v4.gif mike: first look: nice density. question: suppression pill reads as decorative visually. do we want it in the SR string or keep it aria-hidden and announce separately? leah: echo the concern. i recommend announcing it as a verb phrase in the main label: \"notifications suppressed\" so it isnt orphaned from context. jordan: ordering debate: severity-first helps triage, but channel-first helps context. lean severity-first in default and expose an enterprise toggle to swap. test with 6 participants. priya: copy tweaks: change menu item \"Snooze\" -> \"Snooze notifications\" and tooltip -> \"Snooze notifications for this channel\". announce counts as \"2 recent messages\". anya: agree. also thinking to hide full preview in compact by default and surface via chevron / keyboard toggle. avoids clutter. mike: for keyboard flow, let's keep preview toggle before overflow menu to preserve left-to-right scan. BUT ensure menu keyboard handlers are instant (0ms) to avoid perceived delay. leah: small a11y nit: if we put aria-live on the preview region, do not set aria-live on the entire row. some readers repeat on focus. ux-bot: suggested markup pattern (keep preview aria-live-only): ```html
Critical Payments Alerts
``` jordan: good. implementation note: hide visual badges from SR with aria-hidden when the state is duplicated in aria-label to avoid double-read. priya: microcopy: for preview announce use \"showing 2 recent messages\" when expanded. makes it clear why text is spoken. mike: accessibility test plan: VoiceOver mac, NVDA windows, TalkBack android small view. also test with increased text size and prefers-reduced-motion. leah: add keyboard acceptance criteria: preview toggle focusable, tabbable, aria-expanded reflects state, overflow menu reachable and has visible focus outline. anya: added acceptance criteria to INF-1721: severity-first default, enterprise toggle for channel-first, suppression as verb phrase in aria-label, preview aria-live-only, snooze copy updates, keyboard order + reduced-motion. priya: i'll PR copy changes once aria strings are finalized. quick suggestion: SR aria-label should not include redundant words like \"severity\" - keep compact: \"Critical, Payments Alerts, notifications suppressed, 2 recent messages\". jordan: agreed. also test a variant where we read count last vs earlier; users responded differently in prototype. round of user testing needed. mike: visual tweak: bump severity chip contrast slightly and reduce chip font-weight in dense mode. prevents it stealing attention. anya: i'll push a tiny figma update and a prototype link in the ticket. pairing session scheduled Friday 10:00 for SR checks. tagging @jordan @leah for pairing. ux-bot: prototype link: https://redwood-internal.design/INF-1721/compact-row-proto (build 2026-03-22-b). leah: one last accessibility note: include an aria-describedby pointer from overflow menu to a hidden description for menu shortcuts (keyboard hints). helps power users. anya: added that to the ticket. thanks all, will follow up with the usability script and a short checklist for the pairing.
